sqls:
SELECT DISTINCT
  "Đơn số" AS order_id,
  CAST("Ngày HĐ" AS DATE) AS order_date,
  "Mã khách" AS customer_id,
  CASE WHEN "Mã khách" IS NOT NULL THEN "Khách hàng (tên)" ELSE NULL END AS customer_name,
  "Tổng thanh toán" AS total_due,
  "_don_huy" = TRUE OR "Trạng thái giao" = 'Đã hủy đơn' AS is_cancelled,
  "Hình thức thanh toán" = 'Thu hộ (COD)' AS no_debt,
  "Hình thức thanh toán" = 'Ghi nợ' AS is_credit
FROM "banhang_tonghop_banhang_all"
ORDER BY "Đơn số"

SELECT
  p."Ma don" AS order_id,
  CAST(p."Ngày TT" AS DATE) AS pay_date,
  p."Tiền thu" AS amount
FROM "banhang_phieuthu" p
